definition.description: Retrieves the partner's organization profile from Microsoft Partner Center API. Returns company information, tenant details, default address, contact info, and culture settings.

inputFields.helpText: Bearer token for Partner Center API authentication. Typically obtained from an OAuth node.

outputParameters.description: Country code from default address (e.g., SE)
Contact first name from default address
Contact last name from default address
Contact phone number from default address
Entity tag for caching and update operations
The full raw JSON response body
HTTP status code from the API response
True if an error occurred during the request
Error details if the request failed

connectionTags.description: Triggered when organization profile was successfully retrieved
Triggered when the request fails or returns an error status
